desc: menu anchor WITHOUT name/id=Enquire: the anchor is clicked, not its cell
note: querySelector("a") resolves down to the anchor before closest() walks up; the cell is not clicked

desc: a text match on something with no control in it is NOT a click
note: a <span> with no anchor or button inside reports false instead of a phantom success

desc: the same DOM WITH name*="Enquire" is handled correctly by _clickSelector
note: the fast path was always fine; J2-1 covers the fallback that was not

desc: document order is why the fix has to look DOWN, not just up
note: querySelectorAll order = [cell,link] — the cell is always seen first, and td.closest('a') === null, so upward resolution alone can never reach the link

desc: captcha fill focuses the field and fires real key events
note: focused, dispatched [keydown,keypress,input,change,keyup,blur] — a portal handler bound to keypress/keydown, or one that requires focus, now runs

desc: a portal that enables Login on keypress is enabled by our fill
note: the keypress handler ran, the button enabled, and _loginJs clicked it on the first poll

desc: a 120x22 spacer/banner gif is NOT sent to OCR on its shape alone
note: dbg="1 imgs; top 120x22 s-2" → scores 4 (size 3 + wide 1) < 5, so no canvas is rendered and no ML Kit pass runs

desc: the REAL portal captcha is still picked, by name and by position
note: dbg="2 imgs; top 120x22 s13; used 120x22 x3" → the refresh icon is beside the box too, but "reset" scores -6 and loses to IMAGECAPTCHA

desc: an unnamed captcha beside the verification box still qualifies
note: dbg="1 imgs; top 120x22 s8; used 120x22 x3" → 4 (near the field) + 3 (sized) + 1 (wide) = 8 ≥ 5

desc: an OCR read is never written into the reCAPTCHA token field
note: the token field is skipped by name, and it is not a text input either

desc: a genuine captcha input is still filled by the loose fallback
note: tightening the fallback did not break a deployment that renames the field

desc: credsFilled returns "false" while the Keystore read is still in flight
note: empty fields → gate says false → _autofillCaptcha returns with NO retry scheduled
